scope: Convert the developed KartGame presentation to Canvas/Node2D while preserving all 17 racing features, scalar handling, original pack AI and idempotent saves. Do not substitute the partial OperaRacerSurface. Equivalent 2D presentation assertions replace only spatial assertions in the existing feel probe.

preserved_features.owner_priority: Racer specifically has a problem. There's a racing game that's 3d and has already been developed in this game. Converting this engine to our racing engine, versus any others, is a priority

existing_canvas_presenter.qualification: Partial conversion of original handling; not full feature parity.

preserved_features.decision: The developed KartGame is the conversion source. Do not adopt or commission an alternative racing engine. Prioritize its conversion before cosmetic Racer replacements.
preserved_features.feature_assumption: Retain complete engine feature set. A separately requested training subset must be configuration on that engine, with preserved in-world behavior.

features.source_observation: Full engine has motorcycle, kart and monster truck with distinct speed, steer, wall, mass, turbo and slip. Canvas Opera uses only KART_HANDLING.
features.conversion_requirement: Retain all three handling tables and custom vehicle subset support; review proper drawable 2D art separately.

features.source_observation: Full engine has eight paint choices; the Opera race has no paint selection.
features.conversion_requirement: Preserve choice and selection transaction; painted character identity stays unchanged.

features.source_observation: Full engine has independent ocean/rainbow control points, variable width, bank, terrain samples and a reverse-lap variant. Opera uses one painted circuit.
features.conversion_requirement: Convert source geometry to 2D coordinates and preserve measured course length, bend sign, width and reverse semantics. Elevation cues need a truthful 2D treatment.

features.source_observation: Low-end launch pull and boost acceleration already share KartDriving.
features.conversion_requirement: Retain KartDriving; establish before/after race times for every vehicle and policy.

features.source_observation: Full engine supports keys/gamepad/touch and braking; diagonal touch never brakes. Opera has a contained steering surface.
features.conversion_requirement: Retain meaningful input differences and one-finger completion. Keep transformed hit regions, cancel/focus ownership and optional second-finger Turbo.

features.source_observation: The scalar turbo/charge logic is shared; presentation/event/pickup configuration differ.
features.conversion_requirement: Preserve meter costs, vehicle multipliers, touch-assisted auto-fire and delta-scaled strips.

features.source_observation: Both presentations call KartDriving. The developed engine also owns tier spray, release feedback and cancel behavior.
features.conversion_requirement: Keep silver/gold/rainbow thresholds, inside-line gain, release boost and wall/contact cancellation; use bounded Canvas effects.

features.source_observation: Developed race rewards tucking behind a rival with speed and gradual Turbo charge.
features.conversion_requirement: Mechanically carry the exact thresholds and charge rate into the shared 2D simulation.

features.source_observation: Original uses a roster, vehicle-adjusted speed, asymmetric catch-up, inside lines, overtake avoidance and bumper personalities. Opera uses a separately simplified single rival.
features.conversion_requirement: Reuse the developed AI formulas; a training subset may change roster/configuration but must not become a second engine.

features.source_observation: Full engine conserves mass-weighted shoves, treats equal mass symmetrically, and protects Roshan’s earned boost from rival bumps.
features.conversion_requirement: Port exact formulas and thresholds to measured 2D contact geometry. Check both array orders and all vehicle pairings.

features.feature: Shell, star, bubble and rainbow pickups
features.source_observation: Full engine has four immediate effects, respawn cooldowns and a touch magnet; Opera uses pearl collection and zoom strips.
features.conversion_requirement: Preserve visible immediate consequences, source tables and cooldown/magnet limits.

features.source_observation: Full engine automatically launches a readable arc and pays a small zip at landing.
features.conversion_requirement: Keep launch/hang/landing state; separate stable 2D road contact from visible height and shadow without a spatial node.

features.source_observation: Original ocean/rainbow hazards have distinct telegraphs, cooldowns, lateral shoves, slowdowns and free geyser jumps.
features.conversion_requirement: Preserve each consequence and warning; inventory existing 2D source coverage before any named art gap.

features.source_observation: Forward course offers one shortcut per lap, a boost and no repeated reward; reverse route excludes it.
features.conversion_requirement: Retain entry condition, destination, per-lap guard and reverse exclusion in the 2D course.

features.source_observation: Original banks collected pearls incrementally, retries failed persistence without double-add, and banks on pause/quit.
features.conversion_requirement: Keep all save keys, exact economy ownership and idempotence; never let animation or render completion award progress.

features.source_observation: Original accepts every placement after deliberate participation; commits sticker/Galaxy before a short podium; zero-input finishes award nothing. Opera owns its separate career result.
features.conversion_requirement: Keep reward owner per caller, positive finish/return and no duplicate payouts. Apply the current owner-directed imp-rematch contract only in its specified Opera contest scope.

features.source_observation: Original engine hum, speed-responsive chase camera, bounded drift feedback and near-field streaks make speed legible.
features.conversion_requirement: Replace the 3D camera/effects with readable Canvas speed cues. Update only spatial-specific test assertions; retain mechanics floors and measure device costs.

implementation_slices.scope: Freeze the original engine’s tables, course samples and deterministic telemetry; mechanically extract remaining non-rendering mechanics alongside existing KartDriving.
implementation_slices.checks: Compare copied functions/formulas/constants to exact source; before/after vehicle, racing-line, drift, AI and collision telemetry.

implementation_slices.scope: Convert the original KartGame presentation/geometry to true Node2D/Canvas: tracks, vehicles, contact, ramps, hazards, choices, speed cues and podium.
implementation_slices.checks: No new 3D debt; exact shrinking inventory; real touch geometry, aspect expansion, no duplicate actor, source/alpha/native-density review.

implementation_slices.scope: Bind original-engine simulation to the existing contained Opera Racer presenter and retain TUNE → TO THE LINE → RACE; use scoped configurations for training/in-world variants.
implementation_slices.checks: Do not launch an external/spatial kart inside Opera. Movie Lounge/developer-training entry, exact voice ownership, passive/cancel/reentry/return/siblings.

implementation_slices.scope: Run full source/runtime gates and inspect complete actions on Mobile at 1280×720 and expanded aspect; obtain device/child/owner review.
implementation_slices.checks: Parser/inference/analyzer/import/full trusted probes, authority/development, regression inventory, current captures and save replay. No release is requested.

tests.qualification: These are existing applicable gates; none was run or weakened by this source-mapping report.

blocking_gaps: Original KartGame is still Node3D and its production conversion has not been implemented.
No current complete ordinary-route action captures or before/after engine telemetry in this packet.
The Racer painted background has only 1672×941 native coverage; 2048 containers/tiles do not repair this.
Monster-truck atlas is a UV/material texture, not a drawable vehicle. Other candidate vehicle views have provenance/acceptance limits.
Actual device, child and owner acceptance remains pending.

required_evidence: official Godot 4.7.2 resolver and baseline feel probe
